Each R^(-3/4)-angular small cap has L-infinity size at most R^(-5/2) and local weighted L2 squared size of order R^(-3/2), hence L4 size at most R^(-13/8). There are R^(1/2) such pieces, so their l2 sum is R^(-11/8) and the ratio is R^(1/8). The deposited quadrature checker confirms the coherence regime, and the exponent arithmetic was independently recomputed.
